decisions.reason: Despite its flagship status and strategic fit, two years without website presence suggest performance stayed below aspiration levels or the offer reverted to occasional custom use, so management would likely reallocate resources.

The foldable container line fits the core business, but disappearing after an initially dedicated page indicates weaker-than-expected traction or internal consolidation, making withdrawal within a year likely.
As a less prominently promoted pallet line that has remained unobserved for two years, it is the strongest candidate for discontinuation in favor of established products and new development.
The spill-retention pallet addresses a niche, but sustained absence from the website suggests results fell short of aspirations and no longer justify keeping the line active.
This pallet variant overlaps with the firm's broader pallet capabilities, and prolonged non-observation signals that management would likely prune it and redeploy the resources elsewhere.
